      Harbor City Fire Department

      FIRE STATION1

      One engine, one crew, and a 520×384 city of streets, a river and a harbour that keeps catching fire. Answer the calls, send ambulances and divers, and spend what you earn on more apparatus, boats and aircraft.

      RespondSelect a vehicle (1–8), right-click a fire. It finds the road route.Tap a vehicle, then press and hold on a fire (or use Order). It finds the road route.
      DeployThe crew ride along. On scene they dismount and attack.
      TankThe tank runs dry. Park beside a hydrant and press G to connect, or refill at the station.The tank runs dry. Park beside a hydrant and tap Connect hydrant, or refill at the station.
      HoseWater only flows within the vehicle's hose range (12–16 tiles).
      RescuePeople still inside show on the building. A crew at the building brings them out before it comes down.
      MedicalPeople hurt lie on the street on a clock. Send an ambulance; critical cases ride to a hospital (K). Restock kits at a pharmacy (P).People hurt lie on the street on a clock. Send an ambulance; critical cases ride to a hospital. Restock kits at a pharmacy. Both are buttons on the ambulance's card.
      RoadsWrecks and debris block streets and traffic queues behind them. Send a crew to clear them; rescue units are fastest.
      WindFire runs downwind. Check the wind in the top bar before you choose where to hold the line.
      WaterPeople fall in the river and the harbour. Divers by road or boat bring them out; fireboats and air tankers fight fire from the water.
      ApparatusKnockdowns and rescues pay credits. Press B to buy pumps, ladders, tankers, rescue units or ambulances — and sell them back.

      Controls

      Touch
      Tap to select · drag to pan · pinch to zoom · press and hold on the map (or tap Order, then the map) to send the selected unit there · Next jumps to the next incident · the Units and Incidents buttons open the lists
      Left click
      Select the engine, a crew member or a building
      Right click
      Send the selected unit there — on a burning building, the engine is dispatched
      Drag
      Pan the map
      Scroll
      Zoom around the pointer
      Arrow keys
      Pan the map
      1 – 9, 0, Q W S I J L N O Y
      Select a vehicle. Every vehicle has its own key; select one and press Shortcut on its card to give it a different key (Backspace clears it)
      Tab
      Jump to the next incident (fire, forest fire, wreck or injured person)
      Home
      Jump back to Station 1
      U
      Show or hide the unit list (the Units button, top left)
      Double-click a unit
      Select it and find it on the map (in the Units list on the left)
      P
      Send the selected ambulance to the nearest pharmacy to restock
      K
      Send the selected ambulance to the nearest hospital with its patients
      M
      Sound on or off
      Space
      Pause or resume
      D
      Dispatch to the fire that most needs it (one with no unit on it first) — an ambulance goes to the nearest patient
      A
      Dispatch all: every free vehicle goes to an incident of its own — fires, forest fires, injured people, people in the water, wrecks — one vehicle per incident
      Z
      Back all: every vehicle returns to its station (an ambulance with patients goes to the hospital first)
      E
      Deploy the crew at the engine
      R
      Pack the crew back up
      G
      Connect or detach the hydrant supply line
      H
      Send the selected engine back to the station
      B
      Headquarters — vehicles, finance and contracts
      C
      Center on the selected unit or building
      Esc
      Clear the selection

      A building that burns too long collapses, and every collapse drags the city rating down — but the shift never ends. People trapped inside are marked on the building: a crew at the building brings them out before attacking the fire. Park beside a hydrant and press G to hook up a supply line; the station apron refills too. Knockdowns, rescues and treated patients earn credits; there is no budget, so vehicles cost nothing to run.
